ModMetaData.name: Oh You Are So Fast
ModMetaData.author: Nanaloveyuki
ModMetaData.description: Performance and pathfinding fixes for large RimWorld maps and very fast pawns. Local maps keep the movement-aware heuristic and sparse dynamic path data clearing; planet maps use the actual clamped caravan movement cost for correct shortest paths. Work-priority lists are warmed when the work tab closes and invalidated when priorities change.
